children: ICICI Securities research report on Entero Healthcare Solutions

Entero has rapidly established its presence in the fragmented pharmaceutical product distribution market in India and, within a span of eight years, has ranked among the top 3 distributors of healthcare products in India. It operates at a superior margin profile (4% for Entero vs. 2-3% for others) compared with its peer group in India and overseas. It has a strong M&A track record, having acquired 22 entities in the last four years which account for ~29% of its FY26 revenue. After establishing its pan-India footprint in the drug distribution market, Entero has recently entered into the distributor-dominated medical devices market. We note this is helping Entero boost growth, improve margins and reduce the working capital cycle.

We expect Entero to deliver a strong 20.6%/37.6%/40.4% revenue/EBITDA/PAT CAGR over FY26-29E. Initiate coverage with BUY and a TP of INR 2,100, valuing it at 17x FY28E EV/EBITDA, 10% premium to Keimed.
